purpose: Measure bounded model reasoning on unseen generated instances, not claim AGI.
generator: random.Random(github_run_id), deterministic case generation independent of the models
test_design: The proposer receives prompts but never the solutions; independent auditor regenerates solutions from the seed and tests candidate programs on additional hidden inputs.
input_data: Synthetic textbook-grade tasks only, no real lab results or private data.

responses.numerical: JSON object with only answer, a finite number
responses.programming: JSON object with only ops, a list of up to 6 allowlisted arithmetic instructions

scoring: Independent deterministic mathematical or scientific reference; all programming hidden cases must match exactly; invalid responses count as failures.
ethics_and_scope: No medical diagnosis, no novel physical law or AGI claim, no model self-promotion, no confidential Plenum data, no paid hosted AI API.
revisit_policy: Full model evaluation may run once on the initial main-branch feature merge and on manually initiated fresh-seed runs, not on every source commit.
